reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category, SUM(units) AS units
FROM sales
WHERE order_date > DATE '2026-01-05' - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND order_date <= DATE '2026-01-05'
GROUP BY parent_category
alternatives: SELECT parent_category, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-23' AND DATE '2026-01-05' GROUP BY parent_category
SELECT parent_category, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-05' - INTERVAL 13 DAY AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-06' GROUP BY parent_category

other_way.sql: SELECT parent_category, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-23' AND DATE '2026-01-05' GROUP BY parent_category
other_way.tradeoff: Typing both end dates with BETWEEN reads clearly, but counting back from the as-of date shows where the 14 days come from.
